import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.readline
    N, K = map(int, input().split())
    A = list(map(int, input().split()))

    # If a card itself is >= K, then any subset containing it is good,
    # but removing it may make the subset not good. Such a card is necessary.
    # For a card x < K:
    # it is necessary iff there exists a subset sum s from other cards with
    # K - x <= s < K. Then adding x makes it good, removing x makes it not good.
    # Otherwise it is unnecessary.
    #
    # We count cards for which no such s exists.

    A.sort()

    # Prefix DP: pref[i] is bitset of sums achievable using A[0..i-1], clipped to < K
    pref = [0] * (N + 1)
    pref[0] = 1  # sum 0 achievable
    mask = (1 << K) - 1
    for i in range(N):
        x = A[i]
        if x < K:
            pref[i + 1] = pref[i] | ((pref[i] << x) & mask)
        else:
            pref[i + 1] = pref[i]

    # Suffix DP: suff[i] is bitset of sums achievable using A[i..N-1], clipped to < K
    suff = [0] * (N + 1)
    suff[N] = 1
    for i in range(N - 1, -1, -1):
        x = A[i]
        if x < K:
            suff[i] = suff[i + 1] | ((suff[i + 1] << x) & mask)
        else:
            suff[i] = suff[i + 1]

    unnecessary = 0

    for i, x in enumerate(A):
        if x >= K:
            continue  # necessary

        # Need to know if there exists sum t from all cards except i with:
        # K - x <= t < K
        # Combine prefix and suffix achievable sums.
        left = pref[i]
        right = suff[i + 1]

        # Enumerate sums achievable on the smaller side via bit tricks.
        # Check whether there exists l in left and r in right with
        # K-x <= l+r < K.
        needed_low = K - x
        found = False

        # Iterate set bits of left
        bits = left
        while bits:
            lb = bits & -bits
            l = lb.bit_length() - 1
            lo = needed_low - l
            if lo < 0:
                lo = 0
            hi = K - 1 - l
            if hi >= 0 and lo <= hi:
                # Check if right has any bit in [lo, hi]
                if ((right >> lo) & ((1 << (hi - lo + 1)) - 1)) != 0:
                    found = True
                    break
            bits -= lb

        if not found:
            unnecessary += 1

    print(unnecessary)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
